title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming APIs across python/ts/go; ergonomics + parity + v1.111.0
author: Alyssa Chen
description: Unify SDK auth/retries behavior and streaming API ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Motivation: customers and platform code expect consistent retry semantics and a consistent streaming ergonomics surface across languages; discrepancies caused confusion and bugs in production (notably tokenization differences and reconnect behavior). This PR consolidates the retry backoff logic, standardizes token refresh flow for OAuth + API-key fallbacks, adds parity adapters for streaming event formats, and bumps SDKs to v1.111.0. Changes include small API tweaks for ergonomics (non-breaking): a unified AuthManager class in each SDK with consistent configuration names (token_refresh_window, max_retries, retryable_statuses), a stable streaming iterator/async-iterator for Python/TS and a channel-based stream for Go, and parity fixes for TypeScript HTTP headers and Python streaming chunk framing. Includes release notes and migration guidance. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and staged feature flags.
commit_summary: feat(all): add unified AuthManager with token_refresh_window and fallbacks
fix(python): standardize streaming chunk framing and backpressure handling
feat(ts): streaming async iterator + passthrough events for functions/tool-calls
feat(go): channel-based stream adapter + retry middleware refactor
chore(release): bump package versions to v1.111.0 and update changelogs
review_comments: Ravi: Can we ensure the default max_retries matches existing behavior (3) to avoid surprising customers?
Alyssa: Yes — default preserved at 3; added explicit guidance in migration doc.
Marta: TS streaming iterator should expose a `cancel()` method; otherwise users can't early-terminate without leaking sockets.
Alyssa: Added cancel() and unit tests; also added an example in quickstarts.
Jordan: Some flaky tests observed in CI related to timing of token refresh; suggest increasing test timeouts and adding deterministic clock in tests.
Alyssa: Introduced deterministic_clock fixture and adjusted streaming tests; CI rerun green.
ci_checks: integration: sdk-streaming - flaky then pass after rerun
merge_notes: Squash-merged after approvals from Ravi, Marta and Jordan. CI green after addressing flaky streaming test and adding deterministic clock fixture. Automated release pipeline will publish v1.111.0 packages pending e2e canary checks.
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) 1.111.0: unified auth manager, standardized retry/backoff semantics, improved streaming ergonomics and parity fixes.
- Migration: rename retry_window -> token_refresh_window in config OR continue to use existing aliases; see docs/sdk-migration-auth-retries.md for step-by-step guide.
risk_and_mitigation: Low-medium: API surface changes are ergonomic non-breaking additions; token refresh semantics preserved by default. Mitigations: feature-flag rollout, automated canary with production traffic sampling, SDK deprecation warnings for renamed fields.
notes_for_release_engineering: Publish artifacts in order: python wheel, npm package, go modules tag. Coordinate with observability team to monitor token-refresh and stream reconnect metrics for 48h post-release.
qa_checks_done: Unit tests updated/added across SDKs; integration streaming test stabilized with deterministic clock; manual smoke-tested quickstart examples locally for all three languages.
